capability: Check the whole film, not the first few seconds
title: Run the ring end to end.

hook.picture: Close on the whale checking the first stretch of the line with a small ring; the ring glows; the whale nods.
hook.words: I checked it. It looked fine.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The start looked fine. The middle was broken.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: learner previewing their first animated explainer

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the ring only ever circles the first stretch; the rest of the line is dim. Three-times device: three new snaps appear further along, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, each just past where the ring stops.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: We only checked the first part.

stakes.body: The problem ships exactly where nobody looked: the middle of the lesson.

solution_hint: Check the whole film, not a peek.

metaphor.body: A ring is a look at one stretch of the line. Sliding the ring end to end, step by step, turns a peek into a full check.

steps.picture: The ring leaves the whale and slides along the full line, end to end, stopping at even steps.
steps.words: Check the whole film, not a peek.

steps.picture: At the middle step the ring catches the snap and glows copper; the line pauses there.
steps.sound: Ping turns sour on the snap

steps.picture: The whale mends the snap; the ring passes over the same spot again and glows teal; a gate stands at the shore.
steps.words: Found it. Fixed it. Checked again.

steps.picture: The line passes the gate only once the ring has covered every step; the name lands on its post.
steps.words: No full sweep, no ship: a gate.

real_case.claim: p5.js Explainer Lab, check R5 (scene code vs render): gated, but "parity samples ~3 s of 120 s". The proposal is to sample across the whole film.

honest_limit.picture: Push in: every step is lit teal and the line passes the gate, but the pod at the end tilts, unsure what it was shown.
honest_limit.words: Every frame checked. Still hard to follow.

not_this.body: A clean film is not a lesson.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns. The ring sets off from the whale and travels all the way to the far end where the snap was; that stretch lights and holds; the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The far-off snap from bar 2 now sits inside the ring's path and holds, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Check the whole thing, every time.
